tool_args.rationale: The pilot signatures favor the coupled siphon-memory ODE. The extra trajectory batch brings the fit to at least eight observations, providing more leverage to separate memory relaxation from coupling before fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter coupled siphon-memory ODE now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five endpoint observations at similar horizons leave no residual degrees of freedom and weakly distinguish the memory time constant from the coupling strength.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit an uncoupled Kelvin–Voigt or damped oscillator model
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Neither model accounts for the observed gradient dependence and history-conditioned transient.
It does not resolve the ambiguity between the coupled ODE parameters.
